import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1+eps)
    S = np.sqrt(T)
    z = p[0] + p[1]*S + p[2]*T + p[3]*L + p[4]*L**2 + p[5]*L**3 + p[6]*L/T + p[7]*L*S + p[8]*L**2*S + p[9]*L**3*S
    return np.exp(z)
